title: Score-Following Drumming via Sim-to-Real Transfer on a Pneumatic Musculoskeletal Percussion Robot: Code and Data
description: Simulation and deployment code, trained policy checkpoints, and hardware logs accompanying the IEEE Access paper 'Score-Following Drumming via Sim-to-Real Transfer on a Pneumatic Musculoskeletal Percussion Robot: Feedforward Versus Reinforcement Learning on the Same Identified Model'.
